purpose: Phase-5B.1 SIGNAL-TRANSDUCTION CONTEXT registry. Defines the biological contexts (species + cell model + tissue/disease + drug + formulation + molecular target) that a future signaling graph is keyed by. ARCHITECTURE + EVIDENCE ONLY - no runtime engine, no renderer, no animation. Contexts NEVER mix species or cell models. A profile begins only via a declared start condition; the molecular target for Profile B is NOT REPORTED (Phase 5A), so signaling profiles are EXPOSURE-DRIVEN predictions, not target-mediated claims.
authoritative_source: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN). Chen 2012 supports the CELL MODELS (HaCaT human keratinocytes; B16BL6 murine melanoma) and the rat skin permeation model, but reports NO signal-transduction nodes/edges. Therefore all Profile-B signaling here is at best LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION / MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION and MUST be verified against primary sources before Phase 5B.2 upgrades any label. No outside citation is fabricated.
evidence_staging_note: The frozen Profile-B package contains NO signaling data. Canonical pathway EDGES (e.g. ROS->ERK, PI3K->AKT->mTOR, Nrf2->ARE) are classified EXPERIMENTAL_PATHWAY_SPECIFIC as established GENERAL biology, with primary citations to be attached during the Phase-5B.1 review freeze. Drug-in-cell-model claims (celastrol drives these in HaCaT/B16BL6) are LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION pending primary-source verification (verification_status = UNVERIFIED_IN_REPO). Nothing is labelled EXPERIMENTAL_FORMULATION_SPECIFIC.

human_hacat.start_condition_basis: Molecular target is NOT REPORTED (Phase 5A), so signaling is modelled as EXPOSURE-DRIVEN (drug exposure), never implying a known target.
human_hacat.source_context: Chen 2012 used HaCaT for cellular uptake; no HaCaT signaling was reported in the frozen package.

mouse_b16bl6.start_condition_basis: Molecular target is NOT REPORTED (Phase 5A) -> EXPOSURE-DRIVEN signaling only.
mouse_b16bl6.source_context: Chen 2012 used B16BL6 for cellular uptake + in-vivo antimelanoma efficacy (downstream, not modelled here); no B16BL6 signaling cascade was reported in the frozen package.

rat_skin.start_condition_basis: No rat cellular signaling evidence exists; signal transduction is NOT REPORTED for rat. No human/mouse pathway is silently reused.
rat_skin.source_context: Chen 2012 used rat only for ex-vivo skin permeation; no rat signaling.

context_rules.one_species_one_cell_model: A pathway profile binds exactly one context; species and cell models are never mixed within a profile.
context_rules.no_silent_transfer: A human keratinocyte pathway is never auto-transferred to mouse melanoma; a mouse pathway is never auto-transferred to rat. Any transfer is a labelled prediction recorded in signal-prediction.registry.json.
context_rules.target_gating: Signal transduction never begins without a declared start condition. With an unknown target, only an EXPOSURE-DRIVEN predictive profile may exist; a fake generic target must never be used to force a pathway.

provenance_sources: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN) - HaCaT + B16BL6 cell models; rat skin permeation; NO signaling reported
Chen Y et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033 (DOI 10.2147/IJN.S32476)
